title: 第一卷 第9章 本夫人允了第一卷 第10章 都是夫人培养的好
slug: 逆主马奴我以阴阳证大道
lines: 洛寒衣感觉自己的脸颊有些发烫，一时间有些失神。
周围的嘲笑王龙的声音此起彼伏，大比这有武者才有资格参加
洛寒衣缓缓开口，声音虽然不大，却满是威严。
院中却瞬间安静下来。
“王龙，你可知，家奴大比不论生死？”
“若是来不及投降，会死得很惨。”
“老奴自然知晓。”
王龙恭敬的点点头。
“老奴身为侯府的一份子，也想为侯府出力！”
“你可知，参加大比的各家奴仆中，不乏二品、甚至三品武者？”
洛寒衣打算让王龙知难而退，他刚刚成为一品武者，去了也只能当炮灰。
“老奴自然知晓，老奴只想替侯府争光！为大夫人分忧！”
王龙言语自信，周围的人闻言忍不住笑出声。
洛寒衣沉默了片刻，指尖轻轻叩着扶手，她的心被王龙这句话影响。
乱了~
“为了本夫人么？”
洛寒衣嘴角挤出一丝不易察觉的弧度。
王龙明白洛寒衣的顾虑，自己若是战死，她损失最大！
但王龙不会放弃这个绝佳的机会！
洛寒衣盯着他看了良久，手指停止了叩击，心中已然有了计较。
武者不是温室里培养出来的，而是战场上厮杀出来的！
如今洛寒衣跟王龙两人实力相差太大，双修的提升已经微乎其微。
唯有让王龙变强，才能继续帮助洛寒衣本人提升。
这次的家奴大比是个好机会，既然王龙想去，洛寒衣决定给他这个机会。
若是王龙陷入死局，她可以提前认输保下王龙。
思及此，她缓缓开口，声音依旧清冷。
“你倒是有几分胆色，本夫人允了！但愿你不是在说大话。”
“多谢大夫人！老奴自然不会让您失望的！”
王龙目光坚定，瞬间感染了周围的其他人。
一瞬间，院中顿时躁动起来。
王龙一个养了几十年马的马奴都有胆子参加。
自己正是拼搏的年纪，必须拼一把！
一时间，普通的家奴们也都纷纷举手报名。
“我也要参加！”
“算我一个！”
侯府的一百多号人全部踊跃报名参加！
反正现在只是侯府内部的选拔，不会出人命。
若是有幸被选上，是不是可以跟大夫人一亲芳泽？
洛寒衣见状微微颔首，府内护卫有好几个二品武者。
若是王龙胜不了他们，就乖乖跟她双修修，不要想乱七八糟的事情。
当然，王龙如果能越级击败二品武者，洛寒衣会重点培养他，作为自己长期的双修工具人！
不管结果如何，洛寒衣都不亏！
洛寒衣端坐在主位上，修长的手指轻轻一抬。
下一瞬，一百余张泛黄的纸笺从她袖中飞出，精准地飘向院中每个下人手中。
“抽到相同数字者，互为对手。”
content_en:
Luo Hanyi felt that his cheeks were a little hot, and he was a little absent-minded for a moment.
There were many voices laughing at Wang Long around him. Only warriors like this are qualified to participate in the competition.
Luo Hanyi spoke slowly, and although his voice was not loud, it was full of majesty.
The courtyard suddenly became quiet.
"Wang Long, do you know that the domestic slave Dabi does not care about life or death?"
"If you don't surrender in time, you will die miserably."
"Old slave naturally knows."
Wang Long nodded respectfully.
"As a member of the Hou Mansion, this old slave also wants to contribute to the Hou Mansion!"
"Did you know that there are many second- and even third-grade warriors among the slaves participating in the competition?"
Luo Hanyi planned to let Wang Long retreat in spite of the difficulties. He had just become a first-class warrior and would only be used as cannon fodder.
"Of course I know this. I just want to bring glory to the Hou Mansion! I will share the worries of the eldest lady!"
Wang Long spoke confidently, and the people around him couldn't help laughing when they heard his words.
Luo Hanyi was silent for a moment, tapping the armrest with her fingertips. Her heart was affected by Wang Long's words.
It’s messy~
"For this lady?"
The corner of Luo Hanyi's mouth squeezed out an imperceptible arc.
Wang Long understands Luo Hanyi's concerns. If he dies in battle, she will lose the most!
But Wang Long will not give up this excellent opportunity!
Luo Hanyi stared at him for a long time, stopped tapping with his fingers, and already had a calculation in his heart.
Warriors are not trained in a greenhouse, but fought on the battlefield!
Nowadays, the strength gap between Luo Hanyi and Wang Long is too big, and the improvement of their dual cultivation has been minimal.
Only by making Wang Long stronger can he continue to help Luo Hanyi improve himself.
This domestic slave competition is a good opportunity. Since Wang Long wants to go, Luo Hanyi decides to give him this opportunity.
If Wang Lung is in a dead end, she can admit defeat in advance and save Wang Lung.
Thinking of this, she spoke slowly, her voice still cold.
"You are quite brave, my wife agreed! I hope you are not talking nonsense."
"Thank you, madam! Of course I won't let you down!"
Wang Long's firm gaze instantly infected others around him.
In an instant, the courtyard suddenly became agitated.
Wang Long, a horse slave who has raised horses for decades, has the courage to participate.
I am at the age where I have to work hard and I must fight hard!
For a time, ordinary domestic slaves also raised their hands to sign up.
"I want to participate too!"
"Count me in!"
All the more than 100 people in the Hou Mansion enthusiastically signed up to participate!
Anyway, it is just an internal selection within the Hou Mansion, and no one will die.
If you are lucky enough to be chosen, can you have a romantic relationship with the eldest lady?
Luo Hanyi nodded slightly when he saw this. There were several second-grade warriors guarding the mansion.
If Wang Lung can't defeat them, just practice cultivation with her obediently and don't think about messy things.
Of course, if Wang Long can leapfrog and defeat a second-grade warrior, Luo Hanyi will focus on training him as his long-term dual cultivation tool!
No matter what the result is, Luo Hanyi will not lose!
Luo Hanyi sat on the main seat and raised his slender fingers gently.
The next moment, more than a hundred pieces of yellowed paper flew out of her sleeves and floated accurately into the hands of every servant in the courtyard.
"Those who draw the same numbers become each other's opponents."
